# IMMUNIZATION OF MEN WHO HAVE SEX WITH MEN

See immunization information pages located at the bottom of this page for other

indications, contraindications, and one-time dose orders to listed vaccines.

[Patient vaccine history](orz-gtx-abx-joint-legacy-viewer)

[CDC Recommended Adult Immunization Schedule](orz-gtx-abx-cdc-adult-immunization-schedule)

# Specific vaccine orders for men who have sex with men:

[Haemophilus influenza type b: indicated in asplenia, those undergoing](orzid3-gmenu-abx-hib-vaccine-information-page)

splenectomy and HSCT patients. Refer to specific immunization recommendations

for patients with these indications or refer to the Haemophilus influenza type b

vaccine information menu below.

[Hepatitis A: 2 dose series](orz-set-abx-op-hepatitis-a-vaccine-2-dose-series)

[Hepatitis A/B: 3 dose series](orz-set-abx-op-hepatitis-a-b-vaccine-3-dose-series)

[Hepatitis B: 2 dose Heplisav-B series](orz-set-abx-op-hepatitis-b-adjuvanted-vaccine-2-dose-series)

[Herpes zoster: 2 dose series in those age >/= 50yrs.](orz-set-abx-op-zoster-recombinant-vaccine-2-dose-series)

[Human papillomavirus: 3 dose series through age </= 26yrs and for age 27-45yrs](orz-set-abx-op-human-papillomavirus-vaccine-3-dose-series)

based on shared clinical decision making.

[Influenza: one dose annually.](flu-seasonal-influenza)

[Measles, mumps, and rubella: one dose.](orz-set-abx-op-measles-mumps-rubella-vaccine-one-dose)

[Measles, mumps, and rubella: 2 dose series, for those w/additional risk factor](orz-set-abx-op-measles-mumps-rubella-vaccine-2-dose-series)

or another indication.

[Meningococcal A, C, W and Y: indicated in asplenia, HIV, complement deficiency](orzid3-gmenu-abx-menacwy-vaccine-information-page)

or inhibitor use, travel to endemic countries, microbiologists, and college

students. Refer to specific immunization recommendations for asplenia and HIV or

refer to the Meningococcal A, C, W and Y vaccine information menu below.

[Meningococcal B: 2 dose series, for those w/additional risk factor or another](orz-set-abx-op-meningococcal-b-vaccine-2-dose-series)

indication.

[Pneumococcal: for those w/additional risk factor or another indication. Refer to](orzid3-gmenu-abx-pneumococcal-vaccine-information-page)

specific immunization recommendations for patients with these indications or

refer to the Pneumococcal vaccine information menus below.

[Tetanus, diphtheria and pertussis: 3 dose primary series, booster every 10yrs.](orz-set-abx-op-td-tdap-vaccine-3-dose-series)

[Varicella: 2 dose series.](orz-set-abx-op-varicella-vaccine-2-dose-series)
